---
title: "Course Index"
---

Use the search box to find a
concept and click a column heading to sort.

::: {.note}
**Key:** &nbsp; **Pre** = the [primer on RLC circuits](weeks/primer/notes.qmd) &nbsp;·&nbsp; **W1–W4 notes** = the lecture notes for that week
&nbsp;·&nbsp; **T1–T3** = tutorial sheets, with **A, B, C** the prework questions and
**Q1, Q2, …** the tutorial questions
:::

// ---- rendering -------------------------------------------------------------
const tbody   = document.querySelector('#cx-table tbody');
const search  = document.getElementById('cx-search');
const countEl = document.getElementById('cx-count');
let sortKey = 'week', sortDir = 1, filter = '';

const WEEKLABEL = w => (w === 0 ? 'Pre' : String(w));

function srcHTML(list){
  if(!list || list.length === 0) return '<span class="cx-none">&mdash;</span>';
  return '<span class="cx-src">' + list.map(
    ([label, href]) => '<a href="' + href + '">' + label + '</a>'
  ).join('<span class="cx-sep"> &middot; </span>') + '</span>';
}

function plain(x){
  if(Array.isArray(x)) return x.map(e => e[0]).join(' ');
  return String(x);
}

function strip(h){
  return h.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').replace(/&[a-zA-Z]+;/g,' ').replace(/&#\d+;/g,' ').toLowerCase();
}

function render(){
  let rows = CONCEPTS.map(c => ({concept:c[0], week:c[1], intro:c[2], prac:c[3]}));

  const f = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
  if(f){
    rows = rows.filter(r =>
      strip(r.concept + ' ' + plain(r.intro) + ' ' + plain(r.prac)).includes(f)
      || WEEKLABEL(r.week).toLowerCase() === f);
  }

  rows.sort((a,b)=>{
    if(sortKey === 'week'){
      if(a.week !== b.week) return (a.week - b.week) * sortDir;
      return strip(a.concept).localeCompare(strip(b.concept));
    }
    const x = strip(sortKey === 'concept' ? a.concept : plain(a[sortKey]));
    const y = strip(sortKey === 'concept' ? b.concept : plain(b[sortKey]));
    return x < y ? -sortDir : x > y ? sortDir : 0;
  });

  tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(r =>
    '<tr><td class="week">' + WEEKLABEL(r.week) + '</td>'
    + '<td class="concept">' + r.concept + '</td>'
    + '<td class="src">' + srcHTML(r.intro) + '</td>'
    + '<td class="src">' + srcHTML(r.prac) + '</td></tr>'
  ).join('');

  countEl.textContent = rows.length + ' of ' + CONCEPTS.length + ' concepts';

  document.querySelectorAll('#cx-table thead th').forEach(th=>{
    const a = th.querySelector('.arrow');
    a.innerHTML = th.dataset.key === sortKey ? (sortDir === 1 ? '&#9662;' : '&#9652;') : '';
  });
}

document.querySelectorAll('#cx-table thead th').forEach(th=>{
  th.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const k = th.dataset.key;
    if(sortKey === k){ sortDir *= -1; } else { sortKey = k; sortDir = 1; }
    render();
  });
});
search.addEventListener('input', e=>{ filter = e.target.value; render(); });
render();
</script>
